id: title:joethreepwood:random youtube video in brainrot cell

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the Desktop Command Center's Brainrot cell implementation, replacing a local video asset with a YouTube playlist embed and removing orientation-dependent selection. This could affect the Desktop app's Command Center behavior and its dependency on the Quill package.
review.reason: Adds Quill component imports, removes Radix UI Spinner and Text, removes useElementOrientation hook, replaces landscape/portrait video URLs with YouTube playlist embed, switches from <video> to <iframe>, removes orientation-dependent video selection, adds iframe postMessage handshake and playlist-aware playback, replaces Radix Spinner with QuillSpinner.
